minutes.headline: Conservation Commission continued most hearings to July 3, approved a fence and several compliance items, and its chair announced she is stepping down.
minutes.summary: The commission continued several hearings to July 3, approved a negative determination for a fence at 41 Country Road, and held a first look at a pump house addition for PJ Keating that must wait for a state Natural Heritage response. It issued certificates of compliance, accepted a deck field change, approved small Timber Rights Fund purchase orders, heard a preliminary subdivision idea for Northfield Road, and discussed a decision-letter backlog, mower problems and officer nominations.

public_comment.topic: Chair opened general public comment; none was offered at that point.

public_comment.topic: Asked how close Lot 3 of the Old Stone Farm Store project comes to Riley Road and requested readable copies of the drawings.
Explained the as-built deck at 30 Johnson Street is longer than the plan, extended to add access to rear sliders.

budget_items.topic: Beaver deceiver grant and Timber Rights Fund
budget_items.what_was_said: A grant from MSPCA covers part of the beaver management work, and the commission approved a small top-up from the Timber Rights Fund.

budget_items.topic: Replacement purchase orders for Timber Rights Fund
budget_items.what_was_said: Because the new town Treasurer requires purchase orders to be closed at year end, three new POs were approved to replace unexpended FY2023 ones.

budget_items.topic: Replacement mower for Hollis Road residence
budget_items.what_was_said: Members discussed possibly buying a used mower from the Hollis Road trust fund but preferred to seek donations first and tabled the matter.
A member noted a separate effort to move the tenant's rent toward market rate, which could free discretionary money for mowing.

budget_items.topic: Planning grant for Table Rock and Herold Harley access
budget_items.what_was_said: The grant work does not need competitive bidding because of an exemption.

Commission raised no objection to the informal Northfield Road concept of a single subdivision road; no vote taken.

what_happened.line: The commission continued most open hearings to July 3, including the Old Stone Farm Store duplex subdivision and the PJ Keating pump house request.
It approved a negative determination for a fence at 41 Country Road.
It issued certificates of compliance for three properties and accepted a deck change at 30 Johnson Street as a field change to its order of conditions.
It approved three replacement Timber Rights Fund purchase orders after the new Treasurer's year-end closing requirement, and tabled a mower purchase.
The chair will serve until July 3; one chair candidate exists and no vice chair or clerk candidate has been found.

why_it_matters: Projects near wetlands in town, including a subdivision and a pump house, remain undecided until at least July 3, and the pump house also awaits a state Natural Heritage response.
The commission has an unissued-decision backlog and may start July without a full slate of officers, which can affect how fast permits for local projects are finalized.
watch_next: July 3 meeting: continued hearings return, and officer nominations are due.
A status and aging list of unissued decisions, which the administrator is to prepare.

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on nearly every continuance, certificate of compliance, and the 41 Country Road and 30 Johnson Street votes. They differ on the Timber Rights Fund purchase orders, where ours records an MRPC GIS trail work vote the official minutes lack, and on how the PJ Keating pump house item is identified. Check those two first.
